response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced polyglot Staff Engineer with a strong background in GIS platforms and low-latency, high-performance systems. While he lacks recent professional experience in modern C++ or Rust, his extensive work with DLang demonstrates equivalent systems programming capabilities, making him a strong potential fit if the team is willing to allow ramp-up time on the primary tech stack.
strengths: Deep domain knowledge in geospatial data processing and mapping platforms through founding and developing GISCollective.
Proven experience designing low-latency, high-throughput microservices using systems-level languages (DLang).
Highly versatile polyglot engineer with strong distributed systems, CI/CD, and DevOps experience.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with modern C++ or Rust, having only brief C++ exposure in 2014-2015.
Most recent professional roles heavily focus on TypeScript, Node.js, and web-centric full-stack development.
No explicit experience mentioned with routing algorithms, map tiling pipelines, or real-time traffic integration.
